notes.title: Left By Angels – Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Left By Angels[/b] is officially [b]released and available on Steam[/b]![/p][p]Step into a hauntingly beautiful world where mystery, emotion, and survival intertwine. [b]Left By Angels[/b] is a narrative-driven adventure that blends exploration, atmospheric storytelling, and immersive gameplay into a uniquely crafted experience.[/p][h3]🕊️ About the Game:[/h3][p]In a world scarred by loss and isolation, you awaken with fragmented memories and a single purpose: uncover the truth behind what was lost… and what was left behind.[/p][list][*][p]🌠 [b]Rich, emotional storytelling[/b] that will keep you guessing[/p][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]Thought-provoking puzzles[/b] and environmental challenges[/p][/*][*][p]🖼️ [b]Stylized visuals and immersive sound design[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]Original soundtrack[/b] tailored to the mood of every moment[/p][/*][*][p]💀 Choices that shape your journey and reveal hidden layers of the story[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're a fan of indie narratives, atmospheric exploration, or deep emotional journeys, [b]Left By Angels[/b] offers a memorable ride through shadows, silence, and hope.[/p][h3]🚀 Get It Now:[/h3][p]The wait is over—[b]Left By Angels[/b] is ready for you to experience. Play it today and discover what truly remains when everything else fades.[/p][p]👉 [url="#"]Play Left By Angels on Steam now[/url][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who supported the game’s development. We can’t wait to hear what you think—share your experiences, leave a review, and help us spread the word![/p]

notes.title: NEW GAME RELEASE
notes.notes:
The Witches Pond - is a small game based in Bucharest, Romania where You play as a Journalist who investigates so-called paranormal places to reveal the truth that they are fake. Everything goes wrong this time when he meets them, and goes through some events that may or may not seem real...

This game creates the path for future big projects that are already in progress!!

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Tales from Hoia Baciu Forest
notes.notes:
Tales From Hoia Baciu Forest will be a first-person adventure game that will contain multiple parts. 
Part.1 will have a story of a village that seems friendly, but every villager has their own dark secrets.
The game will be released as early access FREE on steam soon and will have part 1 which has short gameplay.
The future stories will have more gameplay and stories based on known mysteries.[previewyoutube=aWYb-G43cjA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.notes:
An open-world RPG based in Romania Bucharest, a parody of Ferentari.
 In the near future after the war, a cousin came back from Texas, America after he was caught by police. Now with the American experience, he wants to rule the hood.
Coming when is ready on steam.
